title: Family Jobs
text:
My mother is a doctor. She works in a hospital. She helps sick people every day. My father is a teacher. He works at a school with children.

My uncle is a farmer. He works on a farm with animals. He gets up early in the morning. My aunt is a pilot. She flies planes to London.

questions.text: Why does the uncle probably get up early?
options: Because he has animals to care for

questions.text: What can we guess about the aunt's job?
options: She works outside on a farm.
She travels a lot for work.

vocabulary.definition: a place where sick people are treated
land where people grow crops or keep animals

paragraph_translations: Moja mama jest lekarką. Pracuje w szpitalu. Każdego dnia pomaga chorym ludziom. Mój tata jest nauczycielem. Pracuje w szkole z dziećmi.
Mój wujek jest rolnikiem. Pracuje na farmie ze zwierzętami. Wstaje wcześnie rano. Moja ciocia jest pilotką. Lata samolotami do Londynu.
